independent_recompute.local_repeat_bitwise_determinism: one full 2,304,000-value record per layer, reference and candidate both exact

validated_strengths: All 22 sealed entries and all 18 generated payloads rehash exactly under the provided M256 seal.
A clean replay on a different GPU, torch and numpy stack reproduces every one of the 18 payloads byte-for-byte; a wrong checkpoint SHA fails before emitting any payload.

Direct checkpoint reconstruction independently reproduces all four source float weight SHA values, all four I_KY_KX_O payloads, all float and UQ0.31 scales, all-zero accumulator initialization and every one of 3,072 channel CSV records.
All 21,233,664 quantized weights lie in [-127,127], no reserved -128 is present, and no preclip saturation occurs.
The maximum checkpoint-specific channel sum(abs(qweight)) is 215,301, so one signed unit contribution per coefficient fits signed19 in both polarities with a 46,842 positive-side margin.
All forty M248 compressed sources, raw SHA values and three packed planes reconstruct exactly, forming the complete 4x10 Cartesian trace population.
An independent full 92,160,000-output GPU replay passes all four predeclared raw-convolution gates, and local duplicate executions are bitwise deterministic for one complete record per layer.
M256 consistently fences its numeric bridge from valid825, running-BN hardware, integrated RTL, cycle speedup, PPA and system claims.

P1.title: The local gate does not execute the proposed integer Acc19-to-scale-to-BN path
P1.evidence: The 92,160,000-output audit compares raw float32 Conv2d against float32 Conv2d with dequantized weights. Across the M248 cohort, 8,027,179 nonzero source values are non-integer amplitudes rather than exact unit support. The stored UQ0.31 scale, amplitude correction, running-BN affine, requantization and ATLIF boundary are not applied by this gate.
P1.impact: The payload and coefficient bound are trustworthy, but they do not yet prove that M241r2 or a fused Conv/BN/ATLIF integer module reproduces the checkpoint computation or preserves valid825 accuracy.
P1.required_action: Build an integer oracle and VCS vector bridge that consumes qweight, the observed per-operator amplitude code, stored scale, running-BN parameters and the ATLIF/requantization boundary; then run valid825 or an explicitly representative heldout equivalence gate.

P1.title: Output-contiguous layout has no feasible resident load/evict and cycle schedule yet
P1.evidence: The four weight payloads total 21,233,664 bytes. One full 96-output tile is 663,552 bytes, while the current residency envelope is 193,728 bytes. The contract and result correctly leave physical_layout_selected and real_address_cycle_schedule_admitted false.
P1.impact: The clean I_KY_KX_O roundtrip cannot yet be converted into bandwidth, latency, area or speedup claims; reloading subtiles may dominate the proposed compute savings.
P1.required_action: Choose the physical lane/source tiling and SRAM macros, emit an address-timed load/evict trace, charge all weight and scale traffic, and feed those measured cycles into the matched simulator.

P1.title: The literal value-mask representation is a byte-expansion result, not a compression or performance win
P1.evidence: Independent aggregation of all 27,648 source-term rows finds the 96-output masks require 8.07x to 8.72x the dense INT8 bytes, while each command serves only 1.47 to 1.58 destinations. Even 16-output masks require 2.72x to 2.77x the dense bytes.
P1.impact: A paper claim based on value repetition or command reduction would be misleading unless mask storage, decoding and issue amortization are changed and measured.
P1.required_action: Treat the current value-mask path as a negative screen. Continue only with a materially different compressed-mask/dictionary format and a bank-feasible cycle model that beats dense bytes and cycles after metadata.

P2.title: The numeric cohort covers ten windows from one DSEC sequence
P2.detail: All samples are zurich_city_09_a. This is adequate for a local bridge check but not for cross-sequence amplitude, density or accuracy generalization.

P2.title: The predeclared raw-convolution thresholds have no documented derivation
P2.detail: The 0.03 normalized-L2 and 0.999 cosine gates are passed with large margin, but a paper-facing acceptance threshold should be tied to downstream accuracy sensitivity or a baseline quantization policy.

P2.title: Exact local Conv metric decimals are toolchain-sensitive
P2.detail: The independent RTX3090 replay and sealed A800 replay agree on population and gate decisions but differ slightly in floating reduction results and maxima. Payload bytes are exactly deterministic; raw Conv decimal metrics should carry environment identity and reasonable precision rather than be treated as cross-platform bit-exact.

P2.title: Transitive model-load dependencies are not all first-class M256 sealed inputs
P2.detail: The M256 seal binds the exporter and contract, while the exporter dynamically imports the profile, H9 loader, model overlay and additional framework modules. M248 records the parent profile SHA, and M257 verified current profile/H9 loader identities, but an exact rerun package should seal the full executable dependency set.

P2.title: The M256 output directory is not a self-contained portable rerun package
P2.detail: Checkpoint, config and 40 M248 sources are external inputs and original load-audit paths are server-absolute. Their hashes are sound and the incoming handoff enabled M257, but a runner plus manifest-resolved input bundle is still needed for paper artifact reproducibility.

allowed_claims: M256 freezes four checkpoint-bound output-contiguous signed-INT8 weight payloads, per-output-channel float/UQ0.31 scales and zero accumulator initializers; all 18 payloads reproduce byte-for-byte across the tested A800 and RTX3090 software environments.
Independent reconstruction verifies 21,233,664 quantized weights in [-127,127], zero -128 codes, zero preclip violations, four exact I_KY_KX_O roundtrips and 3,072 exact per-channel audit rows.
For one signed unit contribution per coefficient, the checkpoint maximum sum(abs(qweight)) is 215,301 and fits signed19 [-262,144,262,143].
The frozen 4x10 M248 source cohort implies and independently exercises 92,160,000 raw convolution outputs; all four dequantized-weight local gates pass.
Checkpoint loading independently reaches overlay 210/210, missing 0, unexpected 0, ATLIF 105 and Shiftmax attention 12.
forbidden_claims: Do not call the raw float/dequantized Conv gate an integer Acc19, scale, BatchNorm, ATLIF or full-network equivalence proof.
Do not claim valid825 accuracy, cross-sequence generalization or PAFT end-to-end accuracy from the ten-window local cohort.
Do not claim the I_KY_KX_O payload has a selected physical SRAM layout, feasible resident schedule, achieved bandwidth or cycle speedup.
Do not claim the current value-mask encoding compresses weights or accelerates the layer; its exact uncompressed byte count is materially worse than dense INT8.
Do not claim integrated RTL, VCS, DC/STA, Formality, PPA, power, energy, system speedup or DATE readiness from M256.
next_gates: Build qweight plus amplitude plus scale plus running-BN plus ATLIF integer equivalence vectors and connect them to M241r2 or the selected Conv island.
Run the quantized path on valid825 and at least several heldout DSEC sequences with explicit accuracy gates.
Select physical SRAM macros and a resident tile smaller than or equal to available capacity, then emit address-timed load/evict and compute cycles.
Do not advance the literal value-mask representation; redesign its metadata format before any further hardware implementation.
Seal a portable exact runner with checkpoint/config/M248 handoff and transitive model-load source identities.
